import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')
sns.pairplot(data=df, hue='species', height=1.5, diag_kind='hist', 
             palette='viridis', plot_kws={'alpha': 0.7, 'linewidth': 1},
             diag_kws={'bins': 20, 'kde': False})
plt.suptitle('Iris Measurements by Species', y=1.02)
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
